integrity: The sharp interval follows from all-direction spherical curvature positivity and its exact attained eigenvalue bounds. Enclosed volumes follow from exact rational spherical moments. Computational sampling is corroborative only; no claim of independent validation.
limitations: Exactly one octahedrally symmetric even degree-four harmonic mode; no claim about mixtures, arbitrary cubic anisotropy, or endpoint faceting. Priority relative to incompletely accessible broader historical support-perturbation material is not definitive.
title: Sharp convexity and volume of the octahedral quartic support family
